about.heroDescription: We believe the best trips begin with a genuine encounter.
about.title:
We share a city.
We connect stories.
about.p1: We are local travelers passionate about Arequipa. Our goal is to offer authentic stays and experiences created by people from here.
about.p2: Unlike big chains, we value personal attention, unhurried conversations and genuine experiences. We’re inspired by sillar-stone architecture, the tradition of the picanterías and the life of our neighborhoods.
about.p3: We want a more mindful way of traveling: getting to know the community, respecting the environment and taking home more than a photograph.

colca.name: Colca, where the condors fly
colca.description: Between endless mountains and villages full of history. An encounter with the grandeur of the Andes.
colca.long: Explore the Colca Valley, its agricultural terraces and Andean landscapes. The Cruz del Cóndor viewpoint offers the chance to watch these birds in their natural habitat; sightings depend on the conditions of the day.

city-tour.name: Secrets of the White City
city-tour.description: Sillar-stone streets, colorful courtyards and the stories only a local knows.
city-tour.long: A walk through the heart of Arequipa: the Plaza de Armas, colonial architecture and the surroundings of the Santa Catalina Monastery. Its colorful walls tell centuries of history. Check which entrance fees and visits are included.

misti.name: Misti: an adventure high above
misti.description: An Andean challenge for those who want to see the world from a different perspective.
misti.long: A mountain experience that requires good physical fitness, acclimatization and specialized guidance. Misti reaches approximately {{altitude}} meters in altitude. The route and departure are confirmed according to weather conditions.

gastronomia.name: Flavors that tell stories
gastronomia.description: Rocoto relleno, tradition and conversations around an Arequipa table.
gastronomia.long: Get close to Arequipa’s culinary tradition through its picanterías and signature flavors. Check the itinerary, the tastings available and the options for special dietary needs.

salinas.name: Salinas, a different horizon
salinas.description: Open landscapes, volcanoes and the unexpected beauty of the altiplano.
salinas.long: Discover the landscapes of the Salinas and Aguada Blanca National Reserve. The look of the lagoon and the presence of wildlife change with the season. Check access conditions before your visit.
